title: Update airdrop return type
body:
Recorded public snapshot used when the GitHub API is unavailable.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Restate the issue as a bounded local evidence mission
- [ ] Hash the source snapshot
- [ ] Produce a Proof Pack a maintainer can review
- [ ] Do not post back to GitHub

This fixture is a public-issue fallback for the Northbridge ProofForge demo, not seeded database rows.
